name: @pith/command-centre
description: Pith M Command Centre: one web app to monitor and operate all 18 Pith Marketing services on the shared engine.

scripts.dev: npm run catalog && concurrently -k "tsx watch server/main.ts" "vite"
scripts.build: npm run catalog && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run catalog && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit
scripts.build:vercel: npm run catalog && vite build && node scripts/build-vercel.mjs
